project.name: tingting
project.description: TingTing transport/logistics monorepo (SilverSea deployment): Express 5 + Drizzle ORM backend, shared contracts & financial calculation package, Docker deploy infra. Graph scope: backend + shared + infra (frontend excluded via .understandignore).

nodes.name: enforcer.ts
nodes.summary: Initializes and caches the Casbin enforcer singleton from model.conf and policy.csv, logging the loaded policy count at process boot.
nodes.languageNotes: Policy CSV is loaded once at boot; tsx watch only reloads on source change, so policy edits require a restart or a no-op edit here.

nodes.name: initEnforcer
nodes.summary: Creates the Casbin enforcer from model.conf and policy.csv, caches it as a module singleton, and returns it after logging the policy count.

nodes.name: getEnforcer
nodes.summary: Returns the cached Casbin enforcer, throwing a clear error if initEnforcer() has not run yet.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Creates the shared Drizzle ORM database client on a pooled postgres-js connection bound to the full schema, exported as `db` with its `Database` type.
nodes.languageNotes: One postgres-js pooled client for the whole app; passing schema to drizzle() enables relational (query API) joins.

nodes.name: migrate-trailers.ts
nodes.summary: One-off migration script that extracts trailer plates embedded in the trucks table into the standalone trailers table, deduplicating plate/type combinations and re-linking trucks, skipping entirely if trailers already exist.

nodes.name: migrateTrailers
nodes.summary: Transactionally copies unique trailer plate/type combos out of trucks into the trailers table (skipping when rows already exist) and links trucks to the new trailer records.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the eleven split Drizzle schema modules (_shared, _enums, core, master-data, pricing, trips, costs, financial, treasury, shipments, ops) so drizzle-kit and `import * as s from '../db/schema'` consumers see a single namespace.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure `export *` barrel — the canonical import surface for every Drizzle table definition in the backend.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Shared server-side formatting helpers for VND currency, Vietnamese date display, HTML escaping, SQL LIKE-term escaping, and image MIME sniffing from magic bytes, used across routes and services.

nodes.name: formatVND
nodes.summary: Formats a number as a Vietnamese-dong amount with an optional currency symbol.

nodes.name: formatLocalDate
nodes.summary: Formats a date for local display without timezone shifting.

nodes.name: escapeHtml
nodes.summary: Escapes HTML-special characters in a string to prevent injection in rendered output.

nodes.name: formatDateVi
nodes.summary: Formats an ISO date string in Vietnamese dd/mm/yyyy style.

nodes.name: formatDateShort
nodes.summary: Formats an ISO date string as a compact dd/mm display.

nodes.name: escapeLikeTerm
nodes.summary: Escapes SQL LIKE wildcards in user input so search terms match literally.

nodes.name: sniffImageType
nodes.summary: Detects the image type (PNG/JPEG/WEBP/GIF/BMP) of a binary buffer from magic bytes, returning a content-type string or null.

nodes.name: ops.ts
nodes.summary: Express router for the OPS operations module exposing ~28 endpoints: orders and shipment pins, wallet summary, expenses with photo upload/resend, settlements with XLSX export, fleet tracking, and admin approve/reject flows — each gated by OPS_ONLY, OPS_APPROVERS, or ADMIN_ONLY Casbin role middleware.
nodes.languageNotes: Role gating via composed Casbin middleware constants per route; settlement exports stream XLSX buffers through sendOpsSettlementXlsx.

nodes.name: seed-dashboard.ts
nodes.summary: Standalone seeder that populates dashboard KPI data — reference config rows, a month of generated trips, receivable ledger entries, and operational expenses — runnable via `npx tsx src/seed-dashboard.ts` and idempotent via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.

nodes.name: seedConfig
nodes.summary: Inserts the dashboard's reference/config rows (ports, routes, container types) with conflict-skip semantics.

nodes.name: generateMonthTrips
nodes.summary: Generates a realistic spread of synthetic trip records across a given month using the available truck/driver assignment pool.

nodes.name: seedTrips
nodes.summary: Inserts the generated month of trips through the trip-composite service, skipping ones already present.

nodes.name: insertLedgerEntry
nodes.summary: Inserts a single customer receivable ledger row for a trip amount on a given date.

nodes.name: seedReceivables
nodes.summary: Builds the customer receivables ledger from seeded trips, including partial-payment states for the attention panel.

nodes.name: seedExpenses
nodes.summary: Seeds a realistic distribution of expenses against the generated trips for dashboard cost charts.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point orchestrating the dashboard seed stages (config, trips, receivables, expenses) in order.

nodes.name: seed.ts
nodes.summary: Master demo/staging seed orchestrator: hashes the shared demo password, then drives every seed submodule — reference data, customers, pricing, sites, ports, fleet, trips, vendor financials, forwarder money, customer AR, bulk data — plus clerk-scope and shipment waves.

nodes.name: seed
nodes.summary: Runs the full demo seed in dependency order: master data and pricing first, then actors, trips and financials, ending with the bulk-data wave.

nodes.name: seedClerkScope
nodes.summary: Seeds clerk-to-customer scope assignments used to exercise per-clerk data visibility rules.

nodes.name: resolveSeedReferenceIds
nodes.summary: Resolves seeded port/route/container-type rows into id lookup maps for downstream shipment seeding.

nodes.name: seedShipments
nodes.summary: Creates demo shipments with containers, documents, and status transitions by driving the real shipment service functions end-to-end.

nodes.name: seed-bulk-data.ts

nodes.name: resolveExistingCustomerIds

nodes.name: genContainerNumber

nodes.name: seedBulkData
nodes.summary: Main bulk seed stage: resolves existing pools (ports, routes, fleet, drivers, customers, suppliers) then generates large intertwined volumes of customers, shipments, and trips.

nodes.name: seed-customer-ar.ts

nodes.name: seedCustomerAr

nodes.name: seedPaymentReceipt

nodes.summary: Upserts demo customer rows keyed by normalized tax code and returns a code-to-customer map for downstream seeders.

nodes.name: seedCompanySettings

nodes.name: seedLongMinhDebitTemplate
nodes.summary: Seeds the customized debit-note template (own column layout) for the Long Minh customer.

nodes.summary: Seeds factory master-data rows linked to customers so the shipment-intake factory dropdown is populated.

nodes.name: seedFactories
nodes.summary: Idempotently inserts factory rows tied to seeded customers using normalized-name matching.

nodes.name: seed-fleet.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds the demo vehicle fleet (tractors and trailers) with driver assignments, matching existing rows by normalized plate/name.

nodes.name: normName
nodes.summary: Normalizes a Vietnamese vehicle or person name for case/diacritic-insensitive matching.

nodes.name: seedFleet

nodes.summary: Seeds the forwarder money flow: advance requests for drivers and one settlement that offsets the seeded OPS expenses.

nodes.name: seedForwarderMoney
nodes.summary: Entry point seeding both the driver advances and the settlement that offsets them.

nodes.name: seedAdvances
nodes.summary: Creates advance requests for demo drivers in varied approval states.

nodes.name: seedSettlement
nodes.summary: Creates an advance settlement that offsets the given OPS expense ids.

nodes.name: seed-identity.ts
nodes.summary: Shared identity-matching contract for all seeders: text normalization plus Drizzle SQL predicates for idempotent lookups on normalized (and nullable) text columns.

nodes.name: normalizeSeedText
nodes.summary: Trims and lowercases seed text for stable identity matching across re-runs.

nodes.name: normalizedTextEquals
nodes.summary: Builds a Drizzle SQL predicate comparing a column to a value under seed normalization.

nodes.name: normalizedNullableTextEquals
nodes.summary: Nullable variant of the normalized-equality predicate that handles NULL column values.

nodes.summary: Seeds per-port container lift pricing by joining the reference-seed port and container-type maps.

nodes.name: seedLiftPricing
nodes.summary: Upserts lift-pricing rows for each port/container-type pair resolved from the reference seed.

nodes.summary: Seeds customer-owned operational sites (factories and pickup warehouses) linked to customers by stable tax code so the FCL/LCL shipment-intake dropdowns are populated.

nodes.name: seedOperationalSites
nodes.summary: Idempotently upserts operational-site rows keyed to customers by normalized tax code.

nodes.name: seed-ports.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds port master data from the generated Excel dataset with derived stable seed codes, skipping ports that already exist.

nodes.name: portSeedCode
nodes.summary: Derives a stable uppercase seed code from a port name.

nodes.name: seedPorts
nodes.summary: Upserts ports from the Excel-derived dataset and returns a name-to-id map.

nodes.name: seed-pricing-tables.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds customer pricing tables (route x container-type rate grids) derived from the reference seed and the seeded customers.

nodes.name: seedPricingTables
nodes.summary: Builds pricing-table rows per customer from reference routes and container types.

nodes.summary: Creates staff user accounts from prod master data with hashed passwords and role codes.

nodes.name: seedProdDrivers
nodes.summary: Creates driver users with license, bank, and salary-type detail from prod master data.

nodes.name: seedProdCustomers
nodes.summary: Upserts the real customer rows (payment terms, contacts) from the Excel delivery.

nodes.name: seedProdSites
nodes.summary: Upserts operational sites with contacts, lift/drop/cleaning info, and maps URLs.

nodes.name: seedProdFleetExtras
nodes.summary: Enriches fleet rows with tractor/trailer pairing, capacities, fuel economy, and inspection deadlines.

nodes.name: seedProdCarriers
nodes.summary: Upserts external carrier companies with tax codes and contacts.

nodes.name: seedProd
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the production seed: shared reference data first, then every prod master-data stage in dependency order.

nodes.name: seed-reference.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds shared reference data (ports, routes, cargo types, container types) structured after the pricing-template layout and returns name/code-to-id lookup maps for all downstream seeders.

nodes.name: seedReference
nodes.summary: Idempotently seeds ports, routes, cargo types, and container types, returning lookup maps for downstream seed stages.

nodes.name: seed-sample-pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds a small sample pricing table used by smoke tests and demos when the full customer pricing grid is not wanted.

nodes.name: seedSamplePricing
nodes.summary: Inserts sample pricing rows for a fixed route/container-type set.

nodes.name: seed-trips.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds realistic demo trips end-to-end: resolves seed actors, ensures trailers, driver-user links, and an external carrier exist, then drives the real shipment-intake, dispatch, and trip status-machine services through varied trip lifecycle states.

nodes.name: resolveSeedActors
nodes.summary: Resolves the seed actor users (dispatcher, accountant, driver, admin) the trip seeder will act as.

nodes.name: ensureTrailers
nodes.summary: Creates any trailer rows referenced by seed trips that do not exist yet.

nodes.name: ensureDriverUserLinks
nodes.summary: Links seed driver personnel rows to their user accounts before trips reference them.

nodes.name: ensureExternalCarrier
nodes.summary: Creates the external carrier company and contact so externally-hauled seed trips resolve.

nodes.name: seedTrips
nodes.summary: Creates shipments and advances them through dispatch and the trip status machine to produce trips in varied live and completed states.

nodes.name: seed-vehicles-from-excel.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds tractors and trailers from the customer's Excel fleet list, pairing trailers to tractors and assigning drivers through the assignment service.

nodes.name: seedVehiclesFromExcel
nodes.summary: Upserts Excel fleet rows as trucks/trailers with driver assignment, idempotent on plate.

nodes.name: seed-vendor-financials.ts
nodes.summary: Seeds vendor-side financials: governed company expenses and fuel invoices in mixed approval states for the payables screens.

nodes.name: seedVendorFinancials
nodes.summary: Entry point seeding company expenses then fuel invoices.

nodes.name: seedCompanyExpenses
nodes.summary: Creates governed company expense records across categories with renewal reminders.

nodes.name: seedFuelInvoices
nodes.summary: Creates fuel invoices in mixed approval states, including pending-correction ones.

nodes.name: wipe.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the FK-safe business-data wipe for reseeding: a preserved-tables contract (users, push_subscriptions, idempotency_keys are never touched) plus a grouped TRUNCATE ... CASCADE plan/execute pair.
nodes.languageNotes: TRUNCATE ... CASCADE lets Postgres resolve FK order, so the table grouping is organizational; the explicit list is the source of truth.

nodes.name: wipeTableList
nodes.summary: Returns the flat list of business tables to wipe from the grouped plan.

nodes.name: planWipe
nodes.summary: Builds the grouped wipe plan used for dry-run output.

nodes.name: executeWipe
nodes.summary: Executes the TRUNCATE ... CASCADE across all business tables on the given database handle.

nodes.name: accounting-transport-register.service.ts
nodes.summary: Serves the accounting transport register: canonicalizes filter input, builds a stable filter fingerprint for report identity, and returns paginated transport rows with readiness metadata for the accounting screens.

nodes.name: canonicalFilter
nodes.summary: Normalizes register query filters (dates, statuses, search) into a canonical comparable form.

nodes.name: buildAccountingTransportFilterFingerprint
nodes.summary: Hashes the canonical filter into a stable fingerprint key identifying a register view.

nodes.name: conditionsFor
nodes.summary: Translates canonical filter fields into Drizzle SQL predicates for the register query.

nodes.name: listAccountingTransportRows
nodes.summary: Runs the full register query with filters, joins, and pagination, returning rows plus readiness metadata.

nodes.name: scoped-by-customer.ts
nodes.summary: Pure row-scope helpers that centralize the "what can this CUSTOMER-role user see?" decision for the customer portal and any customer-reachable operator endpoint: queries are forced onto the user's linked customer set, with a deny-all sentinel for unmapped accounts.
nodes.languageNotes: Impersonation guard design: a CUSTOMER user's caller-supplied customerId filter is always overwritten, and an unlinked account gets sentinel id -1 (real ids are positive serials, so it matches no row).

nodes.name: validation.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny helper that converts a failed Zod parse into a formatted 400 ApiError ("message (field)") consistent with the global error handler, so routes can validate with one throw.

nodes.name: asyncHandler.ts
nodes.summary: Express middleware wrapper that forwards rejected promises from async route handlers to the global error handler via next(err) — required because Express 5 hangs on unhandled rejections otherwise.
nodes.languageNotes: Enables the project convention of try/catch-free route handlers: errorHandler.ts centrally maps ZodError, ApiError, and Postgres unique violations.

nodes.name: auth.ts
nodes.summary: JWT authentication middleware for the whole API: verifies Bearer tokens against the Redis blacklist and the users table, revalidates customer-link drift between token and DB (forcing re-login when admin assignments change), and attaches the AuthUser to req.user; also provides a ?token= asset variant and a throwing getUser accessor.

nodes.name: casbin.ts
nodes.summary: Casbin RBAC authorization middleware enforcing role x resource x action policy at route mount points, plus requireRoles for tighter in-handler gates and a route-scoped allowance matrix (CUS/DISPATCHER inline catalog creates, dispatcher fleet CRUD, OPS recovery-fact posts) carved out of the base policy.
nodes.languageNotes: Route-scoped allowances live in code (hasRouteScopedRoleAllowance) rather than the Casbin policy, so tightly-scoped exceptions like "CUS may POST /config/routes only" stay reviewable next to the routes they unlock.

nodes.name: audit-logs.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Paginated audit-log query endpoint with optional category/search filters and validated sort keys, split verbatim out of the old config router; delegates filtering to the audit-query service.

nodes.name: debit-note-templates.routes.ts
nodes.summary: CRUD for debit-note (Giấy báo nợ) templates where writes use dedicated transactional handlers instead of the crud factory, so clear-other-defaults + insert/update run atomically to protect the single-default invariant; every write is governed (reason + expected version) and idempotent.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents why createCrudRouter is unsuitable here: its beforeCreate + insert run as two non-transactional statements and race to zero defaults under concurrent "set as default" requests.

nodes.name: driver-user-binding.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Single ADMIN-only endpoint that binds a driver to a login user account, delegating optimistic locking and idempotency to the driver-user-binding service.

nodes.name: master-data-import.routes.ts
nodes.summary: ADMIN-only Excel master-data import pipeline: multer receives the legacy single workbook or the Sep-2026 two-file delivery (Data form + User & Role), then analyze/dry-run, batch detail, apply, and reject endpoints drive the master-data-import service.

nodes.name: pricing-tables-governed.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Pricing-table CRUD routed through the price-config governance service: every create/update/delete becomes a governed request requiring a reason, the expected row version, and an idempotency key.

nodes.name: isCustomerScoped
nodes.summary: Returns true for CUSTOMER-role accounts whose queries must be row-scoped to their customer link; callers use it to short-circuit writes customers cannot perform.

nodes.name: customerScopeIds
nodes.summary: Computes the full linked-customer set for a CUSTOMER user (primary pointer plus link rows); returns an empty set for operator roles.

nodes.name: scopedByCustomer
nodes.summary: Purely rewrites a list query's customerId filter to the user's primary customer link, applying the deny-all sentinel for unmapped accounts — the portal impersonation guard.

nodes.name: scopedByCustomerIds
nodes.summary: Row-scopes a list query to the full customer link set with an in(...) filter, falling back to a deny-all sentinel list when the account has no links.

nodes.name: canAccessCustomer
nodes.summary: Gates a single row by testing the row's customerId against the user's scope; routes answer 404 (not 403) on mismatch to avoid leaking the row's existence.

nodes.name: throwValidation
nodes.summary: Converts a ZodError into a 400 ApiError with a "message (field)" display string and semicolon-joined field details.

nodes.name: asyncHandler
nodes.summary: Wraps an async Express handler so rejected promises reach next(err) and the global error handler — mandatory under Express 5.

nodes.name: loadCurrentCustomerIds
nodes.summary: Loads the user's live customer links (userCustomerLinks join plus the primary pointer) from the DB, excluding soft-deleted customers.

nodes.name: sameCustomerScope
nodes.summary: Compares the customer-link set currently in the DB against the scope embedded in the JWT to detect stale sessions after admin reassignment.

nodes.name: authMiddleware
nodes.summary: Verifies the Bearer JWT against the Redis blacklist and active users table, forces re-login when role or customer scope drifted, and attaches the AuthUser to req.user.

nodes.name: assetAuthMiddleware
nodes.summary: Auth variant for static-asset routes (img tags) that cannot set headers: accepts the JWT via a ?token= query param, scoped narrowly to keep tokens out of general API URL logs.

nodes.name: getUser
nodes.summary: Type-safe accessor for req.user that throws a 401 ApiError when unset, preventing non-null assertion crashes if routes are reorganized.

nodes.name: hasRouteScopedRoleAllowance
nodes.summary: Encodes the route-scoped RBAC exceptions evaluated before Casbin: OPS recovery-fact posts, CUS/DISPATCHER inline route/customer/port creates with catalog read/edit bridges, and dispatcher CRUD on trucks/drivers/suppliers.

nodes.name: requireRoles
nodes.summary: In-handler role-gate middleware returning 401 when unauthenticated and 403 when the caller's role is outside the allowlist.

nodes.name: casbinAuthz
nodes.summary: Casbin middleware factory: maps the HTTP method to read/write/delete, consults route-scoped allowances first, then enforces the role x resource x action policy.

nodes.name: tripRouteAuthz
nodes.summary: Trip-surface authorizer that additionally lets ACCOUNTANT and CUS execute the O2C close-maker command (POST /:id/complete) while every other trip operation follows the base trip policy.

nodes.name: receiveWorkbooks
nodes.summary: Multer middleware receiving the legacy single workbook (field "file") or the two-file Sep-2026 delivery (dataForm + userRole) into memory and requiring at least one file before analysis.

nodes.name: requireReason
nodes.summary: Middleware rejecting governed pricing-table writes that arrive without a change-reason string.

nodes.name: advances.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Advance request approve/reject plus the full advance-settlement lifecycle for finance roles — check, approve, reject, reversal, expense adjustment, edit, detail, and Excel/HTML export — all wrapped in idempotent write commands.

nodes.name: billing-documents.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Billing-document (debit note / payment statement) surface for ADMIN/MANAGER/ACCOUNTANT: generate from periods, create, list, detail, adjust, issue, send-for-confirmation, delete, and export with XLSX/PDF rendering and report caching.

nodes.name: credit-overrides.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Customer credit-limit override governance flow: list, create, check, approve, and reject endpoints over the credit-limit service with Zod-validated payloads and idempotent writes.

nodes.name: debt-offsets.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Debt-offset endpoints: dual-entity listing, offset creation, approve, and cancel commands delegating to the debtOffset service behind role gates and idempotency.

nodes.name: fuel-invoices.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Fuel-invoice CRUD with per-trip allocation lines, an approve flow, and a discriminated-union correction command set, all validated by detailed Zod schemas and executed idempotently.

nodes.name: governance-actions.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Generic governance-action surface shared by financial adjustment flows: list/detail plus check, approve, reject, return-for-evidence, and cancel transitions over the governance-transition and adjustment-governance services.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Financial router mount point: composes eleven sub-routers in deliberate order (payments first so direct-money governance commands win over the generic router) and registers ~30 audit events for financial write endpoints.

nodes.name: ledger.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Read-only ledger endpoints: paginated ledger feed, customer balance list, per-customer statement, and statement export (XLSX).

nodes.name: penalties.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Penalty list and insights queries plus create and ADMIN/MANAGER cancel commands with idempotency keys.

nodes.name: snapshot.routes.ts
nodes.summary: AR, AP, and fuel-surcharge snapshot maintenance: dirty-snapshot listings plus idempotent recapture write commands that rebuild stale financial snapshots through a shared runner.

nodes.name: parseRequestId
nodes.summary: Parses and validates the numeric :id route param, throwing a formatted 400 on bad input.

nodes.name: parseId
nodes.summary: Parses and validates the numeric id route param for fuel-invoice commands.

nodes.name: runSnapshotRecaptureWriteCommand
nodes.summary: Shared runner that wraps a snapshot recapture command in the idempotency envelope, handling replay detection and status codes for the AR/AP/fuel-surcharge recapture endpoints.

nodes.name: advances.ts
nodes.summary: Forwarder-facing advance surface: request lists/counts, settlement lists/detail/preview, Excel/HTML export, and creation — handler bodies moved verbatim from the old monolithic forwarder router.

nodes.name: geotag.ts
nodes.summary: GPS fix submission and lookup for photo submissions: POST records an idempotent geotag with per-entity ownership and freshness checks; GET returns the latest fix for an entity.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Customer portal API surface: shipment lists/details with POD file downloads and customer-event acknowledge/delivery-response, debit notes with confirm/dispute/export, and statement with PDF/XLSX export — every read row-scoped to the caller's customer links via scoped-by-customer.

nodes.name: recoverable-costs.ts
nodes.summary: Recoverable-cost endpoints for ADMIN/MANAGER/ACCOUNTANT/CUS/OPS: filtered list, detail, and an idempotent approval/rejection decision request routed to the recoverable-cost service.

nodes.name: coordination.routes.ts
nodes.summary: Shipment coordination leaf: the customer-visible event feed, clerk-to-dispatcher handoff create/resolve lifecycle, and ADMIN/MANAGER review of shipment change requests.

nodes.summary: Shipment documents leaf: document upload and replace, customs declaration create/update, and container batch read/upsert with Zod-validated payloads.

nodes.name: app-settings.service.ts

nodes.summary: Shared handler for order-exchange start/complete: validates the shipment id and expected version, runs inside an idempotent audited transaction, locks the shipment row, enforces forwarder mutable scope and the accounting lock, then stamps the start/completion actor and timestamp while bumping the shipment version.

nodes.name: photos.ts
nodes.summary: Expense-photo endpoints for the forwarder portal: ownership-gated listing (unowned returns 404, not 403), HEIC-safe upload that sniffs the mime type and re-encodes through sharp with EXIF strip and 2048px downscale, and an idempotent guarded delete.
nodes.languageNotes: Two-phase orphan protection: the storage object is uploaded before the DB transaction under an armed durable cleanup lease, which deletes the orphan if the transaction fails or is cancelled.

nodes.name: trips.ts
nodes.summary: Read-only forwarder trip endpoints: the trip list with optional status, search (container number or customer name), and departure-date filters plus per-status counts, and a single-trip detail lookup scoped to the requesting forwarder.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Serves the forwarder expense-type catalog, decorating each type that does not require an invoice with a no-invoice policy snapshot built from its configured evidence types, limits, and approval titles.

nodes.name: forwarder-expense-commands.service.ts
nodes.summary: Owns the forwarder expense write commands (create, update, delete, completion) as idempotent transactional commands, lift-pricing resolution under advisory locks, and the storage-cleanup guard plus locked photo-delete command shared with the route layer.

nodes.name: forwarder.service.ts
nodes.summary: Core forwarder domain service: trip expense lifecycle (create/update/delete guarded by settlement linkage, trip scope, and the shipment accounting lock), expense completion scopes, photo persistence, supplier and expense-type catalogs, and settlement OPS completion summaries; also resolves the forwarder profile and re-exports trip-query helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Former god-module: trip reads moved to forwarder-trip-query.service and write commands to forwarder-expense-commands.service, with this file re-exporting both surfaces for backward-compatible imports.

nodes.name: no-invoice-disbursement.service.ts
nodes.summary: Enforces the no-invoice disbursement policy: freezes policy snapshots from expense-type configuration, validates substitute evidence and same-day/same-payee aggregate limits under advisory locks, decides ALLOW vs RETURN_FOR_EVIDENCE with director/finance-lead approval titles, and produces the no-invoice disbursement report.

nodes.name: resolveLiftPricingForWrite
nodes.summary: Resolves the applicable lift price inside a write transaction: locks the trip-container row, derives direction from the LIFTING/LOWERING expense type, and picks the latest effective non-deleted lift-pricing row matching port, container type, direction, and load state.

nodes.name: acquireForwarderCleanupGuard
nodes.summary: Acquires the orphan-cleanup lease for an expense-photo upload: dedupes against an in-flight idempotency record, arms the durable storage-cleanup guard, and waits out a conflicting concurrent request.

nodes.name: releaseForwarderCleanupGuard
nodes.summary: Releases a storage cleanup-guard lease after a failed upload path, logging release failures without masking the original error.

nodes.name: deleteForwarderExpensePhotoCommand
nodes.summary: Locked delete of an expense photo: verifies ownership and mutable trip scope, checks the optimistic-concurrency timestamp, enqueues durable storage deletion, and removes the DB row.

nodes.name: createForwarderExpenseCommand
nodes.summary: Idempotent expense creation for a forwarder: asserts mutable trip scope, resolves lift pricing for LIFTING/LOWERING types, creates the trip expense, and surfaces the audit entity key for the route audit context.

nodes.name: updateForwarderExpenseCommand
nodes.summary: Idempotent expense update: re-derives lift pricing when lift-relevant fields change, enforces optimistic concurrency and settlement linkage, and delegates the guarded write to updateForwarderTripExpenseInTx.

nodes.name: setForwarderExpenseCompletionCommand
nodes.summary: Idempotent wrapper that asserts mutable trip scope then marks a trip or trip-container expense-completion scope completed or back in progress.

nodes.name: deleteForwarderExpenseCommand
nodes.summary: Idempotent expense delete: gathers audit context (amount, type, trip, supplier), deletes the expense in-transaction with an optimistic-concurrency check, and returns the audit entity key.

nodes.name: resetExpenseScope
nodes.summary: Resets a trip or trip-container expense-completion scope back to IN_PROGRESS after an expense mutation invalidates a prior completion.

nodes.name: setTripExpenseCompletion
nodes.summary: Marks an expense-completion scope completed or in-progress inside a transaction: locks the trip close aggregate, refuses when a non-rejected advance settlement links the scope, upserts the completion row with the actor, and recomputes shipment completion.

nodes.name: getTripExpenseCompletionScopes
nodes.summary: Lists expense-completion scopes for a trip, joined with the completing user's display name.

nodes.name: getForwarderByUserId
nodes.summary: Loads the active OPS forwarder profile for a user id, throwing NoForwarderProfileError when the user is absent, not OPS, or inactive.

nodes.name: validateNoInvoiceExpenseState
nodes.summary: Validates a no-invoice expense against its policy: requires payee name and a reason note, and checks declared evidence types against the policy's allowed set.

nodes.name: lockTripExpenseCreateRelationships
nodes.summary: Pre-creation relationship locking: takes application-owned uniqueness locks, then row-locks and validates the trip, referenced users, supplier, trip container, and lift-pricing row a new expense depends on.

nodes.name: createTripExpense
nodes.summary: Creates a trip expense in a transaction: asserts the shipment accounting lock, locks relationships, snapshots the no-invoice policy, validates state, inserts the expense row, resets the completion scope, and marks report snapshots dirty.

nodes.name: updateTripExpense
nodes.summary: Updates a trip expense on a db-or-tx handle: blocks settlement-linked and accounting-locked changes, revalidates required fields and the no-invoice policy, resolves container labels, resets affected completion scopes, and invalidates report snapshots.

nodes.name: updateForwarderTripExpense
nodes.summary: Forwarder-scoped expense update wrapper: locks the row, asserts mutable trip scope and settlement linkage, then delegates to updateTripExpense inside a transaction.

nodes.name: updateForwarderTripExpenseInTx
nodes.summary: Transaction-scoped forwarder expense update that verifies ownership, mutable scope, and the If-Unmodified-Since optimistic-concurrency timestamp before delegating to updateTripExpense.

nodes.name: getTripExpenses
nodes.summary: Lists all expenses for a trip joined with forwarder name, expense-type name, and operational supplier name, newest first.

nodes.name: deleteTripExpense
nodes.summary: Deletes a forwarder expense in its own transaction: enforces the accounting lock, mutable trip scope, trip status, and settlement linkage, resets the completion scope, and marks report snapshots dirty.

nodes.name: deleteTripExpenseInTx
nodes.summary: Transaction-scoped expense delete with optimistic-concurrency verification plus the same accounting-lock, scope, and settlement guards as deleteTripExpense.

nodes.name: getTripExpenseAuditInfo
nodes.summary: Fetches audit summary fields (amount, type name, trip code, supplier name) used to build expense audit-log messages.

nodes.name: deleteTripExpenseGuarded
nodes.summary: Guarded in-transaction expense delete used by driver-side flows: verifies approval status, trip status, and settlement linkage before deleting and resetting the completion scope.

nodes.name: listUnlinkedTripExpenses
nodes.summary: Lists a forwarder's PENDING/APPROVED expenses not yet linked to any settlement, scoped to the forwarder's shipment assignments and decorated with trip, truck, container, and completion context for the settlement form.

nodes.name: listTripExpenses
nodes.summary: Filtered expense listing across trips by optional trip, forwarder, or expense-type filters, joined with forwarder names and trip codes.

nodes.name: listSettlementOpsCompletionSummaries
nodes.summary: Builds per-settlement OPS completion summaries: resolves each settlement's linked trips, groups expenses by trip container (with trip-level leftovers), aligns groups with completion-scope statuses, and returns sorted trip summaries with completed/total group counts.

nodes.name: addExpensePhoto
nodes.summary: Inserts an expense-photo record linking a storage key to the uploading user.

nodes.name: getExpensePhotos
nodes.summary: Lists photo records for an expense, newest first.

nodes.name: getExpenseTripLink
nodes.summary: Returns the trip id an expense belongs to, for downstream scope assertions.

nodes.name: listForwarderExpenseTypeRows
nodes.summary: Loads the forwarder expense-type catalog including no-invoice policy limits, evidence types, and approval titles.

nodes.name: getForwarderOwnedExpenseId
nodes.summary: Returns the expense id only when it is owned by the forwarder and its trip's shipment is assigned to them through user_shipment_links; null otherwise, which callers map to a 404 to avoid existence leaks.

nodes.name: deleteExpensePhoto
nodes.summary: Deletes an expense photo in a transaction after asserting ownership and mutable trip scope.

nodes.name: listActiveSuppliersForForwarder
nodes.summary: Lists active suppliers with operational names and contact details for the forwarder expense form.

nodes.name: NoForwarderProfileError
nodes.summary: Typed error thrown when an authenticated user has no active OPS forwarder profile; carries a 404 HTTP status consumed by the central error middleware.

nodes.name: buildNoInvoiceAggregateLockKey
nodes.summary: Builds the advisory-lock key (expense type + date + normalized payee name) used to serialise same-day/same-payee aggregate checks.

nodes.name: lockNoInvoiceAggregateScope
nodes.summary: Takes a transaction-scoped advisory lock on the aggregate key so concurrent no-invoice approvals for the same day and payee serialise safely.

nodes.name: buildNoInvoicePolicySnapshot
nodes.summary: Freezes an expense type's no-invoice policy (evidence types, per-item and per-day limits, approval titles, policy version) into the immutable snapshot stored alongside each expense.

nodes.name: getForwarderExpenseTypePolicy
nodes.summary: Loads the no-invoice policy configuration row for an expense-type code.

nodes.name: getTripExpenseNoInvoiceState
nodes.summary: Loads an expense's no-invoice-relevant state (amount, date, payee, invoice number, approval status, declared evidence types) joined with its trip and shipment.

nodes.name: getExpensePhotoEvidence
nodes.summary: Counts an expense's photos and how many carry valid geotags, using a filtered aggregate join against photo_geotags.

nodes.name: sumSameDaySamePayeeCategory
nodes.summary: Sums same-day, same-normalized-payee, same-category expenses (excluding rejected ones and the current expense) to evaluate the per-day aggregate limit.

nodes.name: missingEvidenceLabels
nodes.summary: Computes human-readable missing-evidence labels (payee name, reason, photos, geotag, invalid evidence types) for a no-invoice expense.

nodes.name: resolveRequiredApprovalTitle
nodes.summary: Chooses the required approval title (director versus finance lead) by comparing per-item and per-day aggregate amounts against the policy thresholds.

nodes.name: buildNoInvoicePolicySnapshotForExpenseInput
nodes.summary: Resolves the policy snapshot for an expense about to be written, skipping the snapshot entirely for invoice-backed expenses.

nodes.name: reviewNoInvoiceDisbursementApproval
nodes.summary: Core approval gate for a no-invoice expense: locks the aggregate scope, validates evidence and thresholds, and returns either ALLOW (with required approval title and exception-reason flag) or RETURN_FOR_EVIDENCE with the reason.

nodes.name: getNoInvoiceDisbursementReport
nodes.summary: Builds the no-invoice disbursement report: filters invoice-less expenses by date, forwarder, and threshold, joins trip, type, supplier, and approval-audit context, and returns items with over-threshold totals.

nodes.name: _enums.ts
nodes.summary: Central registry of 54 application-level enum definitions covering trip, shipment, financial, OPS, and master-data statuses and types, consumed by every other Drizzle schema module. Enums are app-owned via applicationEnum, so PostgreSQL stores plain text columns and validation lives in the application layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses applicationEnum instead of native pgEnum so new enum values never require ALTER TYPE migrations on Postgres.

nodes.name: _shared.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny helper module providing the applicationEnum factory that backs every enum definition in the schema layer.

nodes.name: applicationEnum
nodes.summary: Factory that wraps a Drizzle text column builder with a const-typed tuple of allowed values and attaches enumValues metadata, giving schemas compile-time exhaustiveness without native PostgreSQL enums.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a const type parameter (<const Values extends readonly [string, ...string[]]>) so the literal tuple is preserved for exhaustiveness checking.

nodes.name: core.ts
nodes.summary: Platform-level tables: users with RBAC roles, business units and calendar days, audit logs, app settings, durable effect jobs, notifications, push subscriptions, photo geotags, scheduler run logs, and idempotency keys.

nodes.name: costs.ts
nodes.summary: Cost-side tables: driver penalties, expense categories and expenses, trip expenses with photos, fuel invoices with allocations and OCR evidence review, plus driver work days, progress events, and incidental costs.

nodes.name: financial.ts
nodes.summary: The financial accounting schema: canonical trip financial postings, the transaction ledger, debit-note templates, billing documents with lines, trip claims, recoverable claims and disputes, period locks, governance actions, reporting-policy and truck-profile versions, salary periods with confirmations, advance requests and settlements, credit-override requests, and profitability snapshots.
nodes.languageNotes: Imports snapshot types (BillingDocumentOfficialIdentitySnapshot, DebitNoteTemplateSnapshot) from @tingting/shared and persists them as jsonb columns.

nodes.name: master-data.ts
nodes.summary: Master-data tables for fleet and commercial entities: trucks, trailers, drivers with truck assignments, partners, suppliers, tires and positions, customers with user links, routes, cargo/container/seal types, dispatch zones, ports, forwarder expense types, operational sites, master-import batches and row results, and carrier fleet vehicles.

nodes.name: ops.ts
nodes.summary: Field-operations (OPS) module tables per the OpsVanHanh PRD: personal shipment pins, truck-to-ops ownership assignments, cash expense entries with receipt photos, and accountant-approved settlement batches. Money is numeric(15,0) VND with no decimals.
nodes.languageNotes: Enforces at most one ACTIVE ops owner per truck via a partial unique index (.where(sql`is_active is true`)); cross-table FKs are application-level per project convention (no .references()).

nodes.name: pricing.ts
nodes.summary: Pricing configuration tables: per customer-route pricing tables, road allowances and road config, fuel config with price history and fuel norms, weight pricing tiers, lift pricing, ancillary revenue, and penalty reasons.

nodes.name: shipments.ts
nodes.summary: The shipment (lô) dossier schema: shipments with documents, declarations, status history, containers, fulfillments and recovery facts, accounting locks, document custody facts, proof-of-delivery submissions and files, milestones, customer-visible events, delivery attempts and responses, email logs, and dispatch handoffs.

nodes.name: trips.ts
nodes.summary: Trip operations schema: trips with financial state and carrier info, the tripsComposite database view, trip pairs and legs, trip containers and seals, trip code counters, and trip photos.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes pgTable declarations with a pgView (tripsComposite), materializing the operational join surface directly in the database.

nodes.name: billingDocument.ts
nodes.summary: Normalizes debit-note freight line descriptions by upgrading system-generated 'Cước vận chuyển' labels to route-based wording while preserving accountant-authored text. Part of the shared billing-document calculation helpers used by backend document generation and frontend previews alike.

nodes.name: canonicalFreightDescription
nodes.summary: Rewrites TRIP-sourced freight descriptions that match known generated-label patterns into the canonical 'Cước vận chuyển — <route>' form; accountant-authored descriptions pass through untouched.

nodes.name: vehicleAlerts.ts
nodes.summary: Pure, deterministic helper turning a truck's compliance dates (inspection, insurance, oil service) into overdue/due alerts sorted by urgency, parsing dates as local midnight so timezones never shift the day count.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately avoids new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') (UTC-parsed) and instead builds the date from three numeric parts to keep day-diff math local; `today` and `leadDays` are injectable for tests.

nodes.name: parseLocalMidnight
nodes.summary: Parses a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string as local-midnight milliseconds, returning NaN for empty or malformed input so callers can drop it with a Number.isFinite guard.

nodes.name: computeVehicleAlerts
nodes.summary: Computes overdue/due alerts for inspection, insurance, and oil-service dates using ceil-based day diffs and an injectable lead window, returning only non-OK alerts sorted by days remaining.

nodes.name: company-info.ts
nodes.summary: Single-purpose helper deciding whether white-label company profile setup is complete by validating the row against companyInfoSchema, since seeded installations carry blank placeholder rows that timestamps cannot distinguish.

nodes.name: isCompanyInfoConfigured
nodes.summary: Returns true only when a company profile object exists and passes companyInfoSchema.safeParse, separating a fully configured profile from untouched seeded placeholders.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Canonical shared constants module for the monorepo: lifecycle enums (TripStatus, ShipmentStatus, custody and document types), Vietnamese label maps for statuses, roles, costs, and evidence types, financial-role checks, push-notification rules, and dispatch classifications consumed by backend, frontend, and the Zod schema layer.
nodes.languageNotes: Blends TypeScript string enums that mirror Postgres enums with `as const` label records, keeping a single source of truth for both code branching and UI display strings.

nodes.name: canonicalShipmentStatus
nodes.summary: Maps raw or legacy shipment status strings onto the canonical ShipmentStatus enum, providing read compatibility for rows created before the 2026 workflow re-definition.

nodes.name: isFinancialRole
nodes.summary: Type guard checking whether a user role belongs to the FINANCIAL_ROLES set that grants accounting-side visibility.

nodes.name: cus-shipment-workspace.ts
nodes.summary: Zod contract layer for the CUS (chứng từ) shipment workspace: strict paginated query schemas for the overview and container workboards plus response, detail, and container-line schemas covering finance summaries, document custody, accounting locks, debit notes, and recovery facts.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses .strict() objects with distinct sort-key unions per endpoint so the two workboard surfaces keep separate contracts; money values are validated as regex-matched strings to match PG numeric serialization.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Central Zod schema module (and barrel of sibling schema files) for the platform: request/response validation for trips, billing documents, debit-note templates, users, master data (trucks, trailers, tires, routes, customers), expenses, advances, shipments, dispatch, and driver progress, plus reusable numeric transforms for PG numeric columns.
nodes.languageNotes: A fixedScaleDecimal transform accepts number-or-string input and pads the fraction to a fixed scale, preventing string-concatenation bugs when Postgres numeric columns arrive as strings; also re-exports financial-reporting-policy, ocr-settings, and geotag schema modules.

nodes.name: fixedScaleDecimal
nodes.summary: Factory producing a Zod transform that accepts number-or-string input and normalizes it to a fixed-scale decimal string (padding the fraction part), rejecting malformed or over-precise values via ctx.addIssue.

nodes.name: validateShipmentDocumentReferences
nodes.summary: Super-refinement on shipment create/update payloads ensuring at least one document reference (BL number or booking ref) is present, reporting field-specific issues when references are missing.

nodes.name: penalty-list.ts
nodes.summary: Zod query contracts for the admin penalty log API: a strict server-side pagination/filter/sort schema for GET /api/penalties and a month/year schema for the server-computed KPI insights endpoint, replacing the former client-side aggregation.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Domain type dictionary for the entire platform: 2000+ lines of interfaces covering users, drivers, customers, trips, shipments, containers, expenses, advances, salaries, fleet, and dispatch, serving as the single shared contract imported by both the Express backend and the React frontend.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript interfaces layered over enums imported from ../constants; numeric(15,x) DB columns are consistently typed as string to match Postgres-to-JSON serialization.

nodes.name: parseThreshold
nodes.summary: Coerces a raw setting value to a finite number with a caller-supplied fallback, used when reading numeric threshold configuration.

nodes.name: fuelSurcharge.ts
nodes.summary: Computes the customer fuel surcharge when the current fuel price exceeds the contractual base price, splitting the delta by the customer's share percentage over a quota in liters. Returns a zero/non-applicable result whenever any price, share, or quota input is missing or the precondition fails.

nodes.name: computeFuelSurcharge
nodes.summary: Calculates the surcharge as (currentPrice − basePrice) × quotaLiters × sharePct/100, rounded to 2dp then to a whole number via roundInt. Guards against null prices/share, non-positive share or quota, and currentPrice ≤ basePrice by returning { amount: 0, applicable: false }.

nodes.name: round.ts
nodes.summary: Shared numeric rounding kernel for the platform's VND financial precision: round2dp does banker-safe 2-decimal rounding via a scientific-notation trick that avoids float tie-boundary errors, and roundInt rounds to whole liters clamped at zero. Also re-exports the fuel and road-allowance fallback constants from tripFormDefaults for a single import surface.
nodes.languageNotes: round2dp uses parseFloat(n + 'e2') / Number(... + 'e-2') scientific-notation round-tripping because Number.prototype.toFixed and naive Math.round both misbehave on binary floating-point tie cases; the sign × abs split keeps it symmetric for negatives.

nodes.name: round2dp
nodes.summary: Rounds a number to 2 decimal places using Math.round on a scientific-notation shifted value, which bypasses floating-point representation and tie-boundary issues; symmetric for negative inputs via sign × absolute value.

nodes.name: roundInt
nodes.summary: Rounds to the nearest integer and clamps at zero with Math.max, used for fuel-liter quantities because the dispatch system only issues whole liters; the clamp stops negative inputs from propagating through caller code paths.

nodes.name: tripTotals.ts
nodes.summary: Core trip P&L engine shared by backend and frontend: resolves fuel liters by precedence (FLAT_RATE override → fixed route allowance → per-leg AUTO norms), computes fuel cost with actual-vs-standard price variance, road allowance, net VETC toll cost with kẹp-hàng backhaul dedup, VAT-aware freight ex-VAT and recorded revenue after commission, and splits cost/profit math between OWN and EXTERNAL carrier types.
nodes.languageNotes: All VND amounts are rounded to whole units at each step (roundInt for liters, Math.round for money) so leg breakdowns sum exactly to issued totals — flooring per leg before summing prevents sub-liter noise from inflating the total by 1.

nodes.name: computeRoadAllowance
nodes.summary: Derives the driver road allowance: when tollsAddition is positive it replaces the base rate entirely (plus return-cargo bonus), otherwise it uses base − (toll stations × per-station toll) + bonus; subtracts tollsDiscount and clamps the result at zero.

nodes.name: computeTripTotals
nodes.summary: Main trip totals function: resolves fuel liters by precedence (FLAT_RATE → fixed mountain/route allowance → per-leg km×norm) with whole-liter rounding, then assembles the P&L — fuel cost at the effective price (actual ?? standard) with variance tracking, road allowance honoring manual override, net toll cost (gross − kẹp-hàng tollDeduction clamped ≥ 0), freightExVat/recordedRevenue after VAT and customer commission, and the OWN (fuel+allowance+tolls+salary+bonuses) vs EXTERNAL (incl-VAT freight cost only) cost branches.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses nullish coalescing (`??`) rather than truthiness for prices because 0 is a valid numeric price; ancillary service fees are deliberately excluded from transport P&L (serviceMargin pinned to 0) and only feed billing/AR references.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Allowlist-style Docker build-context filter for the backend image: excludes everything with a root `*`, then re-includes only the pnpm workspace manifests, shared/backend sources, and Drizzle migration files that backend/Dockerfile actually COPYs, keeping the root context intact so pnpm workspace links still resolve.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an inverted allowlist pattern (`*` then negated `!` re-includes) with secondary exclusions to strip test files (`*.test.ts`, `*.spec.ts`, `__tests__/`) and Drizzle markdown snapshots from the build context.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the TingTing backend API: a builder stage installs workspace dependencies with pnpm 10 and compiles the shared and backend TypeScript packages, then a minimal node:22-alpine runtime stage ships only the pruned node_modules, dist output, Casbin policies, Drizzle migrations, and BeVietnamPro fonts, running `node dist/index.js` on port 3090.
nodes.languageNotes: Notable techniques: BuildKit cache mounts for the pnpm store and tsc incremental cache keep layers warm across builds; `pnpm deploy --prod --filter @tingting/backend` produces a self-contained pruned dependency tree so root-level QA tooling (Puppeteer) never enters the runtime image.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: Builder stage on node:22-alpine that activates pnpm 10.33.0 via corepack, runs a frozen-lockfile install for @tingting/backend and its workspace dependencies, compiles shared and backend TypeScript with a cached incremental build, and emits a pruned production dependency tree at /prod/backend via `pnpm deploy`.

nodes.name: production
nodes.summary: Runtime stage on node:22-alpine that copies the pruned node_modules and compiled dist from the builder, adds static assets tsc does not emit (Casbin model.conf/policy.csv, Drizzle migration SQL plus meta journal, BeVietnamPro fonts for document rendering), creates the uploads directory, and serves the API on exposed port 3090 under NODE_ENV=production.

nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build-context exclusion list that strips node_modules, VCS/agent-tool state, test and QA artifacts, dist builds, backend tests, drizzle migration snapshots, docs/plans, and all env files from image builds, keeping only README.md and .env.example as negation exceptions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses negation patterns (!README.md, !.env.example) to re-include exceptions after broad globs — keeps secrets out of images while preserving the example env template.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: The repository's binding agent contract: strict trunk-based git workflow (no branches, worktrees, or PRs), closed-loop SDLC with mandatory QA gates (lint, typecheck, backend/frontend tests, build, E2E), testplan-first regression rules for user-reported bugs, and a strict UI-verification claim ladder that forbids calling anything tested without browser-interaction evidence.
nodes.languageNotes: Pairs with CONTEXT.md by explicit division of responsibility: AGENTS.md = how to work, CONTEXT.md = what to load.

nodes.name: CONTEXT.md
nodes.summary: Compact development-context entrypoint defining the authority order for conflicting sources, the repository shape (shared contracts/calculations, Express+Drizzle backend, React frontend, e2e, docs/prd, deploy), core invariants (Drizzle-only SQL policy, round2dp financial math, JWT+Casbin gating), and the progressive context-loading protocol with dev endpoints.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Root orchestration for the entire dev/deploy lifecycle: boots the local stack (compose up, backup-first drizzle migrations, backend :3001 + vite :7174), database utilities (timestamped pg_dump backups, serialized migration generation with a schema-drift guard, prod/staging-to-dev and prod-to-staging DB sync), and the two deploy pipelines — make demo (staging, :latest channel) and make deploy (prod branch AS-IS, :prod channel) — each with rollback image capture, server-side DB backup, flock-serialized migrate, cutover, and public health checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Fail-closed guards throughout: backup size sanity checks abort on tiny dumps, drizzle-kit generate is serialized via a portable mkdir lock (flock is absent on macOS), and prod deploy refuses to run off-branch or on a dirty tree.

nodes.name: docker-compose.dev.yml
nodes.summary: Local development infrastructure stack: pgvector/pg16 Postgres (5441), Redis 7 (6391), and Adminer (8083), all in silversea-* namespaced containers with healthchecks and a persistent pgdata volume so the stack runs alongside the sibling nepocorp project without port or container-name collisions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the pgvector/pgvector:pg16 image because stock postgres:16-alpine lacks the vector extension needed for the FAQ vector(1536) cosine index.

nodes.name: db
nodes.summary: Postgres 16 database with the pgvector extension preinstalled, exposed on host port 5441, with a pg_isready healthcheck (2s interval, 10 retries) and the persistent silversea-pgdata volume backing the silversea database.

nodes.name: redis
nodes.summary: Redis 7 cache instance (silversea-redis) exposed on host port 6391 with a redis-cli ping healthcheck.

nodes.name: adminer
nodes.summary: Adminer web UI for database inspection on port 8083, gated on the db service reaching a healthy state via depends_on condition.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Monorepo root manifest ("tingting", pnpm 10.33): dev/setup/build scripts delegate to Make targets, context and QA tooling scripts (context-for resolver/checker, qa-smoke, seed generators, Excel extractors), strict pnpm dependency overrides pinning security-patched versions (esbuild, uuid, qs, undici, ...), and the repo-wide eslint toolchain.

nodes.name: pnpm-workspace.yaml
nodes.summary: Declares the three workspace packages (frontend, backend, shared) and the pnpm 10 postinstall build allowlist (esbuild, protobufjs, puppeteer, sharp) that controls which dependencies may run install scripts.
nodes.languageNotes: The allowBuilds block holds placeholder template text; onlyBuiltDependencies is the operative allowlist under pnpm 10's default-deny build-script model.

nodes.name: tsconfig.base.json
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript compiler baseline — ES2022 target, strict mode, ESNext modules with bundler resolution, isolatedModules, sourceMap — extended by every package-level tsconfig (backend/tsconfig.json, which tsconfig.build.json in turn extends).

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Backend image build and deployment automation: `push` builds the linux/amd64 image via Docker buildx and pushes it to GHCR (ghcr.io/4rankng/transting-backend) with channel tags (latest = staging/vantai, prod = silversea) plus a SHA-derived secondary tag, while `build-local` produces a fast local image and `link-drivers`/`link-drivers-apply` run an orphan-driver linking utility.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses channel-separated image tags (latest vs prod) so the staging and production deploy flows never clobber each other's images, with registry inline cache (cache-to type=inline) to speed up buildx rebuilds.

nodes.name: package.json

nodes.summary: Base TypeScript config for the backend package: extends the monorepo-root tsconfig.base.json, emits to dist with src as rootDir, and enables incremental builds with a .tsbuildinfo cache; includes all of src for dev-time typechecking.
